title: AFI Life Achievement Award: A Tribute to Eddie Murphy
overview: Comedy trailblazer Eddie Murphy celebrates his legendary film career in this star-studded tribute filmed live in Los Angeles.

title: Ali Wong: Single Lady
overview: After a whirlwind couple of years, Ali Wong returns to the stage to dish on the highs, lows and surprises of dating post-divorce.

title: Andrew Schulz: LIFE
overview: In this razor-sharp yet heartfelt special, Andrew Schulz unpacks the wildest moment of his life — becoming a father.

title: Chris Rock: Selective Outrage
overview: Chris Rock delivers an electric stand-up set on non-racist yoga pants, spoiling his kids, the Kardashians and his thoughts on the Will Smith fiasco.

title: CMXXIV
overview: Turkish comedy heavyweight Cem Yılmaz takes the stand-up stage in this dynamic special – covering everything from cancel culture to regretful tattoos.

title: Dave Chappelle: Equanimity & The Bird Revelation
overview: Comedy titan Dave Chappelle caps a wild year with two stand-up specials packed with scorching new material, self-reflection and tough love.

title: Dave Chappelle: The Closer
overview: As he closes out his slate of comedy specials, Dave takes the stage to try and set the record straight — and get a few things off his chest.

title: Dave Chappelle: The Unstoppable...
overview: Facing a world gone sideways, comedy icon Dave Chappelle delivers bold truths and potent punchlines in this no-holds-barred special.

title: Felipe Esparza: Raging Fool
overview: In a furiously funny special, Felipe Esparza riffs on his tough-love Mexican mom, keeping a marriage spicy and why dairy is more dangerous than drugs.

title: Franco Escamilla: Eavesdropping
overview: Franco Escamilla takes the stage in California for a comedy special filled with humorous observations on gossiping, the pandemic and airport experiences.

title: Funny AF with Kevin Hart
overview: Kevin Hart travels the country with the help of comedy legends to find the next stand-up superstar — with the winner crowned live by your real-time vote.

title: Gabriel Iglesias: Legend of Fluffy
overview: From breaking stereotypes to home break-ins, Gabriel Iglesias brings comedy to life's unexpected twists in this stand-up special.

title: Jeff Arcuri: Nice to Meet You
overview: Jeff Arcuri's rapid-fire wit is nonstop as he balances outrageous jokes with heartfelt reflections on making his wife laugh during her cancer journey.

title: Jeff Dunham: Beside Himself
overview: The ventriloquist, Jeff Dunham, taped his second Netflix special in his hometown of Dallas, TX in the American Airlines Center. He returns with his normal cast of characters including Walter, Bubba J, Peanut, José Jalapeño on a Stick, Achmed the Dead Terrorist, and one of his newest additions Larry, a high strung, chain-smoking, on-again, off-again personal adviser to the President.

title: Jo Koy: Blue in the Face
overview: Jo Koy relives a wild dental disaster, recounts getting fired from McDonald's and celebrates his veteran stepdad in this hilariously heartfelt set.

title: Jo Koy: Live from Brooklyn
overview: In this unfiltered stand-up special, comedian Jo Koy takes on energy vampires, mumble rap, emoji flirting and the surprise of being called a zaddy.

title: Jo Koy: Live from the Los Angeles Forum
overview: Jo Koy owns the stage in a rousing stand-up set about public sneezing, perseverance, the indignities of sleep apnea and getting lost in the Philippines.

title: Joe Rogan: Burn the Boats
overview: Podcast host Joe Rogan delivers a live stand-up set at the Majestic Theatre in San Antonio, Texas.

title: Katt Williams: The Last Report
overview: Back for his fourth Netflix stand-up special, comedy icon Katt Williams delivers his famously bold takes on conspiracies, celebrities and the world at large in this electrifying set.

title: Kelsey Cook: Happy Hour
overview: In this candid and clever stand-up special, Kelsey Cook explores "hangxiety," relives a plane bathroom nightmare and breaks down dating a literal Chad.

title: Kevin Hart: Acting My Age
overview: Older, wiser — and still hilarious. Kevin Hart opens up about his midlife mishaps, from intimacy pills to the perils of unexpected injuries.

title: Kill Tony: Kill or Be Killed
overview: A bucket, a mic and one minute to win over Tony Hinchcliffe and a panel of famous guests. This is stand-up at its most unforgiving — and unpredictable.

title: Leanne Morgan: I'm Every Woman
overview: Morgan showcases her life via intimate tales about her upbringing in a small town in Tennessee, her almost 20 years of marriage, the challenges of parenting her three children, and her first experience as a grandmother.

title: Louis C.K.: Ridiculous
overview: From a bee getting shot in New York City to paying strangers to take his aging father, Louis C.K. unleashes the ridiculous thoughts in his mind.

title: Marcello Hernández: American Boy
overview: Filmed in Miami, Hernández's special features his comedic take on his first-generation American upbringing before a local audience.

title: Martin Matte : La vie, la mort... eh la la..!
overview: Quebecois comedy star Martin Matte serves up embarrassing personal stories, a solution for social media trolls and more in this unpredictable special.

title: Matt Rife: Lucid - A Crowd Work Special
overview: In Netflix's first-ever crowd work special, Matt Rife gets up close and personal with an unpredictable Charlotte audience to riff on all things dreams.

title: Matt Rife: Natural Selection
overview: From his problem with protection crystals to his beef with social media trolls, comedian Matt Rife holds nothing back in this rollicking stand-up special.

title: Matt Rife: Unwrapped - A Christmas Crowd Work Special
overview: From gifts gone wrong to family tradition fails, Matt Rife turns an unpredictable audience into an unscripted holiday special.

title: Mike Epps: Delusional
overview: Follows comedian Mike Epps as he discusses how a little delusion and a lot of hustle made him a star.

title: Ralph Barbosa: Cowabunga
overview: Dallas comedian Ralph Barbosa talks about how he grew up with his grandparents and ran a hair salon in his bedroom when he was 13 years old.

title: Ricky Gervais: Mortality
overview: Ricky Gervais tackles life, death and the state of the world in a brutally honest special that spares no topic, even his own mortality.

title: Shane Gillis: Beautiful Dogs
overview: In a rowdy stand-up set, Shane Gillis riffs on his girlfriend's Navy SEAL ex, touring George Washington's house and being bullied by an Australian Goth.

title: Stavros Halkias: Uncle Stav
overview: In this unruly set, Stavros Halkias imagines becoming a "dirtbag" uncle, roasts the health care system and warns of the risks of living your best life.

title: Taylor Tomlinson: Prodigal Daughter
overview: Taylor Tomlinson takes her fans to church with hilarious confessions about dating in her 30s, her dream assistant and why she refuses to use AI.

title: The Roast of Kevin Hart
overview: Kevin Hart is in the hot seat and ready for all the smoke as roastmaster Shane Gillis and a dais of A-listers unleash a raw and ruthless night of laughs.

title: The Roast of Tom Brady
overview: Offensive lines. Full-contact comedy. Kevin Hart hosts this all-star roast of NFL legend Tom Brady.

title: Tom Segura: Teacher
overview: Parenting fails. Blackout bar stories. Career regrets. Tom Segura explores the darkly funny side of life's most unpredictable lessons.

title: Trevor Noah: Joy in the Trenches
overview: From unexpected social media beef to a therapist's truth bomb, Trevor Noah turns chaos into comedy in this hilariously sharp, playful stand-up set.

title: Your Friend, Nate Bargatze
overview: In his third Netflix special, Nate Bargatze tackles pizza-ordering strategies for guys' night, wanting a second dog and relying on his responsible wife.
